name: Jazzy’s Doggy Spaw
tagline: Where dogs leave happier than they arrived.
brandNarrative:
Jazzy's Doggy Spaw isn't your average clip-and-go grooming shop — it's a place where even the most reluctant, shady-background rescue dogs make real progress, and temperamental shih tzus end up not wanting to leave the groomer's arms. That's the kind of magic that happens at 628 N Riverside in Medford, Oregon, where Fabby and Jazzy have built something genuinely rare: a grooming experience rooted in patience, kindness, and a deep understanding of anxious animals. Customers like Judith have been returning for over two years because Fabby works with dogs like Freddy — a stray who 'does not cooperate with grooming at all' — and turns each visit into measurable progress. Dolores's temperamental shih tzu was carried out in Fabby's arms after a single visit, completely at ease, which says more than any award plaque ever could.

The space itself reflects the care behind the brand. Reviews describe it as adorable and spotlessly clean, with an open play-and-lounge area that lets dogs decompress rather than spend their entire visit crated and stressed. Photos show a modern interior with decorative fencing, artificial grass patches, and a large circular pet bed where dogs genuinely relax — design choices that feel deliberate and animal-forward. Grooming results run the gamut from pearl-collar-and-pink-bow polished to creative color work with bright orange fur dye, proving the team can read what each pet parent actually wants and deliver it precisely. The shop earned a Best Pet Grooming Company 2025 award, and based on the consistency of the reviews, it's easy to see why.
ownerStory: Jazzy is the name behind the spaw, and from the moment she opened her doors in Medford, it was clear this wasn't a business built on volume — it was built on trust. Groomer Fabby, who is the heart of the day-to-day client experience, has cultivated a reputation that loyal customers like Regina, Judith, and Dolores talk about with genuine affection. Fabby's approach is disarmingly simple: she goes slow when a dog needs it, reaches for scissors instead of clippers when a sensitive face demands it, and treats every animal as an individual rather than an appointment slot. When Dolores's shih tzu — a dog with a documented history of grooming anxiety — chose to stay in Fabby's arms at pickup instead of rushing to her owner, that moment captured everything Jazzy's Doggy Spaw stands for. This is a place run by people who clearly love animals more than they love efficiency.

services.name: Bath & Brush-Out

reviews.text: I have a shih tzu and she's very temperamental. She was incredibly patient and accommodating. Using scissors when necessary. Taking extra time with her around her face. faq.question: My dog is anxious and has had bad experiences at other groomers. Can you help?
faq.answer: Absolutely — this is actually one of our specialties. Groomer Fabby has worked with dogs described as uncooperative, temperamental, and rescue dogs with difficult backgrounds. She works at the dog's pace, uses scissors instead of clippers when needed, and takes extra time around sensitive areas like the face. Many of our regulars came to us after failing at other grooming salons.

faq.question: What makes Jazzy's Doggy Spaw different from other groomers in Medford?
faq.answer: Our open lounge area lets dogs relax and socialize instead of sitting in a crate the whole time. Our groomers are known for patience and genuine love for animals — customers regularly report that their dogs didn't want to leave. We also deliver exactly the groom you ask for, whether that's a classic breed cut, a precise scissor trim, or creative color styling.

faq.question: Do you work with small or temperamental breeds?
faq.answer: Yes — we regularly groom shih tzus, bichons, and other small or reactive breeds. Fabby is experienced in handling dogs that other groomers struggle with, and she adapts her technique to suit each dog's temperament.

faq.question: What are your hours and how do I book an appointment?
faq.answer: We're open Tuesday through Friday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed on Saturdays and Sundays. To book an appointment, give us a call at (541) 531-0947 — we don't currently have online booking, so a phone call is the best way to get scheduled.

faq.question: Do you offer creative or fashion grooming like fur coloring?
faq.answer: Yes! In addition to classic grooming, we offer creative styling including pet-safe fur dye. Our portfolio includes bold color work like vibrant orange dye with stylish sweater pairings — perfect for pet parents who want their pup to make a statement.

faq.question: Is the shop clean and safe for my pet?
faq.answer: Cleanliness is something customers consistently notice and praise. The shop is described as spotlessly clean with a modern, well-designed interior including a dedicated lounge area, artificial grass, and open play space — all designed to keep your dog comfortable and stress-free during their visit.

brandColors.note: Soft lavender purple evokes a spa-like calm and premium feel that matches the 'Spaw' branding — elevated, gentle, and a little playful. Blush pink as an accent nods to the pink bows and pearl accessories in the grooming photos, and reflects the warmth and femininity present in the shop's personality. Together they feel boutique, caring, and distinctly not corporate.
